entities.summary: Mohammad Hosayn Âyrom was a senior military leader of the Pahlavi dynasty of Iran during the reign of king Reza Shah. He was the nephew of General Teymur Xân Âyromlu and a first cousin of Queen Tâj ol-Moluk Âyromlu. Only some members of the Ayrums family spelled their surname "Âyromlu" with the added suffix "-lu".
